name: Thumbli - Get YouTube Thumbnails
description: Show, copy, and download available thumbnails for the YouTube video in your current tab.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; img-src 'self' https://i.ytimg.com https://img.youtube.com data: blob:; connect-src 'self' https://i.ytimg.com https://img.youtube.com;
